title.en: Creating Barangays San Martin, Sta. Cruz, Fatima, San Pedro, San Rafael, Sto. Nio and Citrus in the Municipality of San Jose Del Monte, Province

text.en:
There are hereby created out of the territory now known as Barangay Bagong Buhay in the
Municipality of San Jose del Monte, Province of Bulacan, the following new barangays: San Martin, Sta.
Cruz, Fatima, San Pedro and San Rafael, and out of the territory now known as Barangay Minuyan, same
municipality, Barangays Sto. Niño and Citrus. The Director of Lands shall within four months from the
approval of this Decree survey and determine the relative metes and bounds of the said new barangays,
subject to the approval of the President of the Philippines.
Barangays Bagong Buhay and Minuyan shall remain as barangays and shall continue to exercise and
discharge over the areas specified in the law of their creation, except the areas included in territory of the new
barangays herein created.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law now or hereafter applicable to regular
barangays shall be applicable to the new barangays of San Martin, Sta. Cruz, Fatima, San Pedro, San Rafael,
Sto. Niño and Citrus.

The present elective barangay officials of Barangays Bagong Buhay and Minuyan shall continue
to perform their duties as such officials in the newly created barangays until the barangay officials of said
barangays shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office until their
successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for barangay officials following the issuance of this
Decree and shall have qualified, unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive
officers and employees as may be necessary to organize or to complete the government personnel of
Barangays San Martin, Sta. Cruz, Fatima, San Pedro, San Rafael, Sto. Niño and Citrus shall be appointed as
provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Barangays San Martin, Sta. Cruz,
Fatima, San Pedro, San Rafael, Sto. Niño and Citrus in the obligations, funds, assets and other property of
Barangay Bagong Buhay and Minuyan, respectively, shall be transferred by the President to the newly created
barangays upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and
Seventy-Eight.
